test_output_summary: All 74 tests passed (23 config tests + 21 logging tests + 30 other tests). Previously 7 logging tests were failing due to file handler configuration issues.
implementation_notes: Fixed file logging handler configuration in src/core/logging.py. The main issues were: 1) The handlers from logging.basicConfig() were not being properly attached to the root logger because structlog.configure() with cache_logger_on_first_use=True was creating cached loggers before handlers were added. 2) The max_bytes and backup_count settings from LoggingSettings were not being passed to RotatingFileHandler. Changes made: Added max_bytes and backup_count parameters to configure_structlog() with defaults matching LoggingSettings, updated configure_logging() to extract and pass these values, and fixed handler configuration to properly attach handlers to the root logger after structlog configuration.
